defect_description: Padding-free packing resets position IDs at each independent document, but the collator supplies a dense all-ones attention mask that permits cross-document attention and leaves every later document's first token active as a cross-document next-token target.

repair.description: Preserve the reset position IDs, omit the dense attention mask so the model derives independent packed segments, and set labels to -100 at every reset position so no document boundary creates a cross-document target.
